questions.question: Describe the sol-gel process in detail, outlining each step from sol formation to final material synthesis.
questions.solution_html:
• The Kroll process is a widely used method for extracting titanium metal from its ore, titanium
  • dioxide (TiO₂), typically in the form of rutile or ilmenite.
  • Step 1: conversion of TiO2 to Ti Cl4. :TiO₂ is reacted with chlorine gas (Cl₂) in the presence of coke
  • (carbon) at high temperatures ,TiO₂+2Cl₂+2C→TiCl₄+2CO
  • Step 2:Reduction of TiCl₄ to Titanium Metal: TiCl₄ is reacted with magnesium (Mg) or sodium (Na)
  • in an inert atmosphere. TiCl₄+2Mg→Ti+2MgCl₂
